correctness.rationale: The exclusion is mathematically correct. Kegel--Schmalian print the one-variable Alexander polynomials for both \(L9a20\) twist families. In the noncollision ranges \(|m|\ge3\), \(n\ge4\), and \(n\le-5\), the displayed coefficient \(-7\) survives. Independent collection of coincident exponents in the eleven exceptional parameters reproduces the stated maximum absolute coefficients \(7,13,9,7\) for \(m=-2,-1,1,2\) and \(7,7,5,13,9,7,7\) for \(n=-4,-3,-2,-1,1,2,3\). Since an \(L\)-space knot in \(S^3\) has normalized Alexander polynomial with all nonzero coefficients equal to \(\pm1\), every nonzero family member is excluded.
